channel.title: GO687 Travel – Japan Travel Tips
channel.description: Practical Japan travel guides from GO687 Travel

item.title: Earthquake in Japan: what tourists should do
item.description: What to do in an earthquake in Japan as a tourist: before, during and after, tsunami warnings, emergency numbers 110 and 119, and the apps to install.

item.title: How to ask for an English menu in Japan
item.description: Show this to the waiter: 英語のメニューはありますか？ (Eigo no menyū wa arimasu ka?) = “Do you have an English menu?” Pronunciation, likely answers and backup phrases.

item.title: Japanese restaurant phrases every tourist needs
item.description: Essential Japanese phrases for restaurants: getting a table, ordering, allergies, paying the bill and etiquette — with romaji, pronunciation and meaning.

item.title: Is the JR Pass worth it in 2026?
item.description: Japan Rail Pass prices after the October 2026 increase, the simple math to know if it pays off, what it covers, Nozomi rules and cheaper alternatives.

item.title: Kyoto in 2 days: the perfect first-timer itinerary
item.description: Kyoto in 2 days, hour by hour: Fushimi Inari, Kiyomizu-dera and Gion on day 1, Arashiyama and Kinkaku-ji on day 2 — with transport and where to stay.

item.title: Narita and Haneda Airport to Tokyo: train, bus or taxi
item.description: How to get from Narita and Haneda airports to central Tokyo: Skyliner vs Narita Express, airport buses, Keikyu and Monorail from Haneda, prices and times.

item.title: Shinkansen guide for first-time visitors
item.description: First Shinkansen trip? Which station to use (Shin-Osaka, not Osaka), travel times, Nozomi vs Hikari, JR Pass rules, big luggage and how to buy tickets.

item.title: Suica and PASMO in Japan: how IC cards work for tourists
item.description: How Suica and PASMO IC cards work in Japan, Welcome Suica vs regular cards, adding Suica to Apple Wallet, where they work, topping up and what to avoid.

item.title: Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka in 7 days
item.description: A 7-day Japan itinerary for first-timers: Tokyo, Kyoto, Nara and Osaka day by day, Shinkansen times, where to sleep and whether the JR Pass is worth it.

item.title: Tokyo to Kyoto: Shinkansen, bus or flight?
item.description: Tokyo to Kyoto: Nozomi Shinkansen in about 2h15, highway buses from ¥3,000 or flights via Osaka — times, prices, the Fuji seat and which to choose.
